main_text.p: 22.in quibus locis respondet Hebraeo בקע, quod Siclum dimidium interpretantur. Plural. תִּקְלִי, תִּקְלִין, 1.Sam.17.5.Hos.3.2. Hebr. שְׁקָלִים.
מַתְקַל, מַתְקָלָא Ch.Pondus. Plur.masc. מַתְקָלִין Pondera, Eccles.2.8. constr. מַתְקְלִידְקוּשְׁטָא Pondera veritatis, Prov.16.11. foem. מַתְקָלִין, Exo.38.21.Jon.

תקן ܬܩܢ Syr. Rectum esse vel fieri, restitui, Mar. 8.25. Matth.12.13. 2.ad Cor.5.13. Pahel תִּקֵּן Expendit, perpendit: Aptavit, adaptavit, accommodavit, disposuit, ordinavit, direxit, correxit, rectificavit, rectum, aequum, bonum, conveniens fecit, emendavit, restituit, resarcivit, paravit, praeparavit, confirmavit, stabilivit, statuit, constituit; Ornavit, adornavit. Aphel אַתְקִין Idem. Hophal Praet. הִתְקְנַר Directus, cofirmatus fui, Dan.3.33. Ithpah. אִתְתַּקַּן Dirigi, corrigi, ordinari: Ornari: Aptari, parari: Firmari, confirmari, firmum, stabile esse. Syr. Praeterit. ܐܬܬܩܢ Quod ordinata sunt, ad Hebr.11.3. Ex Ithpehal Praet. וְאִתְתַּקִּינַר Et ornavit se, Hos.2.13.
תִּקִּין תִּקֵּן Ch. Rectum, commodum, aptum, paratum, conveniens, bonum, pulchrum. Plur. תִּקִּנִין, תִּקְנָיָא, Foemin. תִּקְּנָן, emph. תִּקְנְתָא.
תִּקּוּן Ch. Ordinatio, directio, correctio: Ornatus, ornamentum, cultus, mundus. Plur. תִּקּוּנִי, תִּקּוּנִין.
ܐܬܬܘܩܢܐ Syr. Directiones, correctiones, emendationes, Act.24.3.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; some vowel points and Syriac letters are uncertain. The Hebrew word at bottom right (תקע) is a catchword-like marker set apart from the text and is given here as printed.
